title: Novis completion file
description: Values the editor offers in a string argument at the method parameters this file names. The file is data and is never run. The language server checks the methods and parameters it names.

sets.description: Named lists of values. A set's name is shared by every completion file in the workspace.

parameters.description: The parameters values are offered at.

list.description: An array of values, or an object whose values are split on a separator and offered one segment at a time.

separator.description: The character each value is split on. Typing it opens the next segment's list.

value.description: A value: the text to insert, or an object with that text in `value` and the fields of the completion item.

label.description: The text the list shows. It is `value` when left out.

labelDetail.description: Text shown right after the label.

labelDescription.description: Text shown at the end of the line, after the label.

kind.description: The item's icon. It is `value` when left out.

title.description: The heading of the item's details and of its hover.

documentation.description: Markdown shown under the title. A relative link or image resolves against this file's folder.

deprecated.description: Shows the item struck through, and gives a hint where a program uses the value.

sortText.description: The text the list sorts the item by.

filterText.description: The text the list filters the item by. It is `value` when left out.

preselect.description: Selects the item when the list opens.

location.description: Where the value is defined. Go to definition on the value opens this place.

file.description: The file, relative to this file's folder.

replacement.description: The value to use instead of this deprecated one. The hint's quick fix writes it.

attachment.description: One parameter and the values offered at it.

method.description: The method, as `Class::method` with the class's whole name. A constructor is `Class::constructor`.

set.description: The name of a set in `sets`, in this file or another one.

when.description: Offers these values only when another argument of the call is a string equal to one of `equals`.

parameter.description: The other parameter's name, without its `$`.

equals.description: The string, or the strings, the other argument must equal.

strict.description: Warns on a string written at this parameter that is not one of its values.
